answers.text: OA-1 (agent access): an agent gets the intersection. A group is visible to an agent only if it is in the agent's own valid membership rows (existing, same tenant) AND visible to the person it acts for. If that person is unknown, revoked, not a person, or in another tenant, the agent sees nothing.
OA-2 (default k): use k=10 as in the interface; the different number in the done line is a mistake.
OA-3 (snippet): either is fine; the simplest is the first 120 characters of the current body.

OA-P2 (owner review test): you are right, that test contradicts R2a (no standing owner access to member health). Do not change access control and do not change the test. Leave it failing; the engineer will remove it.
